appearance.subtle: They talk with their mouth a little too closed.
appearance.obvious: Their tongue is far too long for their mouth, and it shows when they speak.
appearance.extreme: A grey prehensile tongue, long as a forearm, which they use to pick things up without appearing to think about it.

description: Your tongue is much longer than it was, and it has muscle all the way down. Useful. Deeply unpleasant to watch.
name: Prehensile Tongue
